card.name: Verbs and links in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: Words in ALL-CAPS label text (warnings, precautions) that sit just before a following word, such as verb endings (OUTWEIGHS, DISCONTINUE, PRECEDED, IMPEDING) and small linking words (FOR, HAS, TIMES, WITH).

modes.label: Verb endings
modes.description: The last piece of an all-caps verb, such as DISCONTINUE or OUTWEIGHS, before 'THE'.
modes.example: PENICILLIN ALLERGY. IF AN ALLERGIC REACTION TO CEFTAZIDIME FOR INJECTION OCCURS, DISCONT<<INUE>> THE DRUG. SERIOUS ACUTE

modes.label: Linking words
modes.description: Short all-caps words like FOR, HAS, WITH or TIMES that link a statement to its next phrase.
modes.example: AE. MINERAL AND ELECTROLYTE SUPPLEMENTATION MAY BE REQUIRED. FOSCARNET SODIUM INJECTION IS INDICATED<< FOR>> USE ONLY IN IMMUNOCOMPROM

card.writes: Promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly odd fragments with no clear meaning; it weakly pushes against the next word starting with A.
card.plain: It fires on verbs and small joining words inside warnings printed in capital letters.
